analyzed_vuln.description: Use-after-free is caused by the fuzzer harness itself in case 51: it creates a SkTextBlob via make_fuzz_textblob(), draws it with canvas->drawTextBlob(...), then later explicitly calls free() on the blob's internal run/glyph memory (ASan free at FuzzCanvas.cpp:1569). GPU text rendering is deferred, so GrTextBlob::generateFromGlyphRunList / SkGlyphRunListPainter later reads glyph IDs/positions from that freed text-blob storage, producing UAF in SkGlyphRunPainter.cpp:376.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires the api_mock_gpu_canvas harness to execute draw command 51 (drawTextBlob) with a fuzz-generated blob from make_fuzz_textblob(). On Ganesh/mock GPU canvas, command buffering/deferred text processing keeps references to blob run data past draw call return. The harness then frees the same backing allocation before GPU text processing consumes it, so a later glyph-run walk (drawGlyphRunAsBMPWithPathFallback loop over glyphRun.glyphsIDs/positions) dereferences freed memory.
